Currently, **Hermes Desktop pre-built binaries are Apple Silicon (`arm64`) only**. The "macOS 12+" requirement indicates the minimum supported OS version for the build, not architecture compatibility. Intel (`x86_64`) is not packaged in the current desktop installer release.

### Alternatives & Workarounds for Intel Macs:

1. **Use the CLI version:** You can run Hermes Agent directly via the terminal on Intel Macs using Python. Follow the standard CLI setup in the repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git
   cd hermes-agent
   pip install -r requirements.txt
   ```
2. **Build from source:** If you require the desktop UI, you can clone the repository and build the desktop client locally for the `x86_64` architecture.

*(Note: If you need pre-compiled Intel binaries, open a feature request on the [Hermes Agent GitHub Issues](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/issues) page to request Universal/x86_64 build targets in the CI/CD release pipeline).*
